steps.name: Refine and plan
steps.instructions: Inspect the task, its direct blockers and their high-level artifacts. Refine the approved brief into this task's concrete acceptance criteria, implementation approach, risks and meaningful checks. Resolve details independently where project rules allow; ask the orchestrator for a human decision only when necessary. Save a task-specific implementation_plan. Do not treat the brief's high-level plan as a finished implementation design.

steps.name: Implement and test
steps.instructions: Implement the agreed task in its verified worktree when this is development work. Follow project rules and the task-specific plan, add or adjust meaningful tests, run relevant checks and fix failures. Save test_report with results and any remaining blocker; do not claim success while checks fail. Work continuously unless a real blocker or human decision prevents progress.

steps.name: Review and resolve findings
steps.instructions: Independently review the complete task changes against acceptance criteria, project rules, security, test results and diff. Save review_report with findings, evidence and verdict. If findings remain, tell the orchestrator exactly what to fix; it arranges corrections and runs you again on this same step. Do not advance until findings are resolved and affected checks pass; do not approve merely because an artifact exists.

steps.name: Update project documentation
steps.instructions: Load kos-project-docs and follow the target project's documentation requirements, path and format. Update user-facing behavior, scenarios, results and limits, then run applicable checks. If project rules do not require documentation or this task has no user-visible change, inspect the relevant rules and record why no edit is needed. Save documentation_report with the changes or reason, checks and any blocker. Continue without asking unnecessary questions; if documentation is required but its path is undefined, ask the orchestrator to clarify before proceeding.

steps.name: Publish and verify
steps.instructions: Publication is part of this assigned task; no separate per-step permission is needed. Follow the target project's publication rules and the orchestrator's verified task worktree; inspect status, complete diff, tests and review, and use its required branch, merge or PR route. Never override a project-specific restriction or publish when a real blocker remains. Confirm the result at the destination, then save publication_report with verifiable commit or PR reference and destination. If publication fails or is ambiguous, preserve the worktree, report the blocker and stay on this step. Tell the orchestrator when publication is confirmed; only the orchestrator may complete the KOS task after verification.
